rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded/partially collapsed blastocyst and loose TE, but it overstates confidence about a visible compact ICM and speculates on A vs B features that are not clearly discernible in this single blurred image.
Thoroughly integrates age, tubal factor, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, prior failed cycles, and lifestyle factors into prognosis and transfer planning.

Reasoning is logical and structured, with appropriate caveats about single-image limitations and prior failures; only minor tension exists between calling the embryo good quality and questioning the reported grade.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET at age 30, standard luteal support, no bed rest, selective workup after repeated failure, and cautious use of PGT-A/add-ons. Minor overreach appears in lifestyle counseling and broad implantation workup suggestions.

Provides clear practical next steps for proceeding with transfer, lifestyle optimization, and targeted review if unsuccessful, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than cycle-specific.
